round4_actual_response.REVIEW_SUMMARY: This review independently re-read GitHub for the new REQUEST_ID/CONTROL_ID and did not rely on the prior rendered response. At review start PR #1 was open and draft on poc/c2c-v2-github-bus-r1 with head exactly 86c40d36a20bc42b6256bbf959a13319d9dd1beb. The requested evidence commit was fetched directly. review_request.json identifies implementation_commit ee9e74650a35b2fa0e3491c1a96544b0068ff3ed. GitHub compare shows the evidence commit is exactly one commit ahead of that implementation commit and adds only review_request.json, test_summary.json and source_hashes.json for iteration 004. The actual implementation commit and patch were fetched, every required source/test/protocol path was independently fetched at the exact implementation commit, and every required Git blob ID matched source_hashes.json. Source review confirms the intended core protections are present: strict Fresh version/build/component readiness, ephemeral control token, exact extension origin and loopback authority, append-only at-least-once attempts, persisted send intent before dispatch, replay validation, restart without automatic resend, explicit retries, canonical first valid result with later valid replies classified as duplicates, exact request/control/attempt/tab/URL/component reply binding, full-wire user matching, user/unknown turn barriers, positive paired-turn completion evidence, and observe_attempt separated from composer/send creation. The substantive defect is confined to same-version content maintenance: background reinjects the four Fresh files, but fresh_content.js exits before replacing an existing 0.9.8 listener, while that listener retains captured old Locator/Contract references. Because current tests only establish that executeScript was called and maintenance returned complete, they do not close this false-success condition. Therefore PASS_CONTINUE is not justified until the bounded repair and regression are committed and represented by new Round 5 evidence.
